diane: Quick alert  merged cust/lotus/lora-v1 and pushed an int4 q4f variant to canary. Running the customer quickpack shows embedding quality regression. Opening triage thread.

ryan: Drop the eval summary and tag?

diane: Model tag: lotus-lora-v1-q4f (LoRA merge -> bnb q4f quant). Eval run: 
```
rwi-eval run --suite lotus-cust-quickpack --model lotus-lora-v1-q4f --batch 160 --cache-prefix on
```
Quick metrics: recall@10 0.60 (int8 baseline 0.82), mrr 0.10 (baseline 0.21), p@5 0.58 (baseline 0.79), median_latency 34ms (baseline 52ms). Many top-3 swaps; CS reported 3 customer examples.

mohit: Any tokenizer or preproc changes in the merge?

diane: None  merge only added adapter tensors. Quant config used: 
```
quant_backend: bnb
quant_mode: q4f
adapter_only: true
per_layer_scaling: true
```
We tried cache on/off and warm-prefix on/off, regression persists.

eval-bot: Regression ticket RG-2026-1122-05 created -> https://issues.redwood.ai/RG-2026-1122-05

ryan: My suspicion: bnb q4f per-layer scaling is shifting the adapter projection subspace. Quick experiments to run: nf4 backend, q4f w/ per_layer_scaling=false, and adapter-aware quantizer. I'll kick off a small grid and a layer-scan.

mohit: Also run a small targeted set of 20 customer queries (the ones CS pasted) to see top-1 flips and cosine diffs.

ryan: Running NF4 quick test: 
```
rwi-eval run --suite lotus-cust-quickpack --model lotus-lora-v1-q4f --quant-backend nf4 --batch 160
```

infra-bot: Canary route event: canary/lotus -> lotus-lora-v1-q4f (pool: canary-eu-1)

ryan: NF4 run done: recall@10 0.77, mrr 0.19, p@5 0.75, latency ~36ms. Much improved but small gap to int8.

mohit: Good. How about toggling per-layer scaling?

ryan: q4f + per_layer_scaling=false -> recall@10 0.78, mrr 0.20, p@5 0.76, latency 35ms. q4f + adapter-aware-quantizer -> recall@10 0.80, mrr 0.21. Best config so far: nf4 OR q4f with adapter-aware + per_layer_scaling=false.

diane: Sample customer query diff (cosine):
`q: "invoice overdue Jan 2024"`
- int8 cos: 0.84 -> doc 992
- q4f(bnb) cos: 0.57 -> doc 121
- q4f(nf4/per_layer_scaling=false) cos: 0.81 -> doc 992
Small numeric shifts cause top-1 flips on several examples.

eval-bot: Layer-scan started: `rwi-eval --layer-scan --model lotus-lora-v1-q4f --quant-backend bnb --output /tmp/lotus-layerscan.json`

ryan: Layer-scan summary (quick): adapter projection layers 2 and 4 have the largest embedding displacement under bnb-q4f with per-layer scaling. Low-rank outputs appear to get overscaled in the bnb per-layer flow.

mohit: Given customer impact, propose immediate rollback to int8 on canary, and a pipeline patch to prefer nf4 or enable adapter-aware quantizer for adapter-only LoRA quant. Also add an embedding-drift gate to the LoRA onboarding quickpack CI (threshold: recall@10 drop < 0.03 vs int8).

diane: Agreed. I'll open rollback PR: `rwi-deploy promote --model lotus-lora-v1-int8 --route canary/lotus --reason "restore retrieval quality"` and notify CS.

infra-bot: Deployment promoted lotus-lora-v1-int8 -> canary/lotus (change id: DPL-12021)

ryan: I'll open a pipeline PR that sets `prefer_adapter_nf4=true` and adds the CI gate. I'll attach grid artifacts (q4f vs nf4 x per_layer_scaling true/false x adapter-aware flag) and small unit tests comparing recall on the quickpack.

mohit: Also add a short-cost note: nf4 patch increases CPU decode slightly but keeps token cost savings vs int8. We should include that in the PR description so the PM/cust teams know tradeoffs.

eval-bot: Artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/evals/lotus/1812345679-grid-scan.json

cs-bot: CS note prepared (draft): brief explanation, mitigation (rolled back canary), ETA for patch + smoke: 24-48h. Attach the 3 customer example diffs.

diane: Thanks all. Follow-ups assigned: Ryan -> pipeline PR + grid artifacts; Mohit -> add unit test + CS example set; Diane -> coordinate rollout + smoke after patch lands. End thread for now.
